frontier.hypothesis: The dist_sq scratch-block C8-reload (target: sra;sw;lw;mult vs ours: sra;mult with the register value reused, no reload) is the load-bearing residual; forcing it -- or discovering it's actually an allocation-driven spill rather than a C-source-controllable reload -- closes most/all of the remaining 25.
